verdict.rationale: LocalAI runs as a headless server. The docs show a one-line `docker run` that exposes an OpenAI-compatible API on localhost:8080, CLI commands (`local-ai run`, `local-ai models list`), and `PRELOAD_MODELS`/`--preload-models` for provisioning models without the UI, which together suit scripted automation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or examples for running in CI pipelines, a non-interactive mode for the approval-gated `local-ai chat` agent, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
